section_summary.extract_value: This discussion section summarizes a study investigating a model of body appreciation in college women. The study explored interpersonal and intrapersonal factors influencing body appreciation and its connections to intuitive eating and depressive symptoms. Key findings include body appreciation's mediational role in the link between maladaptive perfectionism and intuitive eating, and the identification of barriers and facilitators to body appreciation.
